description: This file defines the 'Provider' class in the OpenMRS project, representing a healthcare provider linked to a person, with attributes like identifiers, roles, and specialties.

classes.name: Provider
classes.description: Represents a healthcare provider, linking to a person and including metadata about roles and specialties.

methods.name: Provider
methods.description: Constructor initializing Provider with a specific providerId.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier of the provider (from getProviderId()).

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the provider's identifier (delegates to setProviderId).

methods.name: setPerson
methods.description: Associates a Person object with this Provider.

methods.name: setRole
methods.description: Assigns a role concept to the provider.

methods.name: setSpeciality
methods.description: Assigns a specialty concept to the provider.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the provider.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Provides the full name of the person linked to the provider if available, otherwise logs a warning.
